title: [AUG-188] Compact Mode daily-use controls: widget switch, restart Live Text, Ghost Caption copy and text tools, Dock Square pause, action items to Praxis
why_we_need_this: Rodion went back to the standard mode because Compact Mode lacks controls he needs every meeting (@docs/feedback/2026-11-rodion-feedback.md). Research AUG-178 compared the standard-mode controls with each compact widget and agreed the scope with the user on the mockup @docs/mockups/AUG-178/compact-controls.html. Without these controls the user has to expand August mid-meeting to copy text, switch to the transcript, restart Live Text or send items to Praxis, so Compact Mode (M3) does not get daily use.
acceptance_criteria:
P1
- [x] Switch in place: Dock Strip head and Ghost Caption tools have [ ⇄ ]. Clicking ▤ N on Dock Square or Ghost Coin switches Square ↔ Strip or Coin ↔ Caption without expanding August. The switch stays within its variant, lasts for this recording only (Settings unchanged), and the transcript widget can't be chosen while Live Text is off.
- [x] Start Live Text again: the standard view has [ ▶ START LIVE TEXT ] in the circuit recording info. Dock Strip turns its STOP LIVE TEXT slot into [ ▶ START LIVE TEXT ], Dock Square and Ghost Coin show [ ▶ LIVE ], and Ghost Caption shows a [ ▶ ] tool. It works after Stop Live Text and in a recording started without Live, uses the saved live engine, and the window starts empty. Recording and audio are not interrupted, on both Windows and macOS. (Windows checked; macOS pending)
- [x] Ghost Caption copy toolbar: hovering shows a row on the top edge of the lines with [ COPY ALL ] [ COPY & CLEAR ] [ CLEAR ]. They behave like Dock Strip: Copy & Clear clears only after the clipboard write succeeds, and CLEAR shows CLEAR TRANSCRIPT? [ YES ] [ NO ] when skipClearConfirmation is off. New ghost commands are added to ghostProtocol.
P2
- [x] Dock Square Pause/Resume: an icon in the top row, shown only while Live is on, amber when paused. Default-mode recordings still have no pause.
- [x] Ghost Caption text tools: [ A− ] [ A+ ] step the text size through 12/14/16/18/22 px (default 14). [ ◐ ] cycles the background opacity through 40/60/78/90/100 % (text stays 100 %). Both are saved as new preferences, clamped in sanitizeCompactPreferences, and survive a restart.
P3
- [x] Action items → Praxis in Dock Strip and Ghost Caption: a per-item → and a header [ → PRAXIS ] expand August and open the existing Send to Praxis modal with the item(s) preselected (D1, no one-click send).
General
- [x] The widgets match @docs/mockups/AUG-178/compact-controls.html. 0 border-radius. Red only for destructive actions and muted state. Dock Strip still fits 280 px with no horizontal scroll. Ghost Caption at 72 px height hides the text toolbar without clipping the tools.
- [x] Client build and server tests pass. Compact Mode was checked by hand on Windows, and macOS is checked or listed as pending in the card.
important_constraints:
Source: research AUG-178-904wfy; mockup @docs/mockups/AUG-178/compact-controls.html (decisions D1–D6 on the page).
Do not change: one hold-to-stop mechanic (AUG-182), mic mute behaviour (AUG-181), Ghost drag/position/width (AUG-187), pause = live-text pause only (decision 2026-10-29).
Out of scope (D6): Copy in Dock Square / Ghost Coin, participants fields in compact.
Main files: @client/src/components/compact/DockWidgets.tsx, @client/src/components/compact/GhostApp.tsx, @client/src/components/compact/ghostProtocol.ts, @client/src/components/compact/CompactLayer.tsx, @client/src/services/compactStore.ts, @client/src/components/FileUpload.tsx, @electron/src/compact.ts, preferences store.
Roadmap: M3 Compact Mode.

## Verification status (2026-11-04)
- Done: client build (tsc + vite), server tests 37 files / 585 tests, electron compile.
- Done: manual check on Windows by the user in the dev build ("всё работает").
- Review fix: Dock Strip tools row is always visible (was hover-only from AUG-182; the mockup shows it permanently).
- PENDING (manual, macOS): same list; especially Start Live Text with avfoundation server capture.
- Decisions: server capture always starts with live: true (tee drained when unused) so Start Live Text can attach in a Default recording; upload liveKey goes through a per-recording holder; restart keeps the same liveKey and the server store replays its items (action items continue); Copy uses a new main-window-only IPC august:write-clipboard (hidden main window has no document focus in Ghost Mode); no change in electron/src/compact.ts (ghost window is reused for caption↔coin).
- Not committed yet.
